hero.title: Mastering The Art Of Timeless Precision.

showcase.title: Real Wrists. Authentic Craftsmanship.
showcase.subtitle: A mechanical watch is not an accessory, it is a daily ritual of winding, wearing and appreciating a living machine.

cards.title: Crown By Crown Morning Awakening
cards.desc: A few gentle turns of the screw-down crown wake the Swiss caliber from its rest. The rotor tops up the mainspring with every movement of your wrist, so the watch is ready before your coffee is.
cards.quote: The soft tick of the rotor is the first sound of my morning.

cards.title: Sapphire-Clear Dial Appreciation
cards.desc: Under a double-domed anti-reflective crystal, the hand-lacquered sunburst dial shifts from deep emerald to gold as the light moves. Applied indices and blued hands reward every second glance.
cards.quote: Every time I check the time, I notice something new on the dial.

cards.title: Worn Today, Inherited Tomorrow
cards.desc: Marine-grade steel, synthetic ruby bearings and a five-year atelier guarantee mean your Aurelia is built to keep perfect time for decades, and to be passed down with its story intact.
cards.quote: My father wore a mechanical watch. Now I understand why.

orbit.name: Sapphire Crystal
orbit.desc: Double-domed anti-reflective synthetic sapphire crystal with 9 Mohs hardness rating.

orbit.name: Automatic Caliber
orbit.desc: Self-winding mechanical heart beating at 28,800 vibrations per hour for seamless sweep.

orbit.name: 72h Power Reserve
orbit.desc: Twin-barrel spring mechanism maintaining uninterrupted precision for 3 full days off the wrist.

orbit.name: 316L Stainless Steel
orbit.desc: Corrosion-resistant surgical alloy hand-polished with alternating brushed satin bevels.

orbit.name: Ceramic Bezel
orbit.desc: 120-click laser-engraved scratch-proof ceramic diving bezel with platinum numerals.

orbit.name: Super-LumiNova
orbit.desc: Grade A Swiss photoluminescent pigment ensuring vivid low-light dial legibility.

orbit.name: 200M Water Proof
orbit.desc: Triple-sealed gasket assembly pressure-tested to withstand deep oceanic expeditions.

orbit.name: Exhibition Caseback
orbit.desc: Transparent sapphire rear display showcasing gold rotor and Geneva stripes decoration.

orbit.name: Incabloc Shock
orbit.desc: Spring-loaded jewel bearing absorbing severe sudden mechanical shocks and drops.

orbit.name: Glucydur Balance
orbit.desc: Beryllium-bronze alloy balance wheel resisting extreme temperature fluctuations.

orbit.name: Nivaflex Mainspring
orbit.desc: Space-age alloy providing consistent kinetic energy torque with zero magnetic distortion.

orbit.name: Sunburst Dial
orbit.desc: Hand-lacquered emerald dial with radial sunburst brushing and applied gold hour indices.

orbit.name: 25 Jeweled Bearings
orbit.desc: High-purity ruby bearings virtually eliminating mechanical friction on internal pivot points.

orbit.name: Italian Calfskin
orbit.desc: Full-grain Tuscan leather strap with artisanal tone-on-tone edge stitching.

orbit.name: Butterfly Clasp
orbit.desc: Spring-actuated double folding security buckle with laser-etched brand insignia.

orbit.name: COSC Certified
orbit.desc: Independently certified by the Official Swiss Chronometer Testing Institute within -4/+6s.

orbit.name: Helium Escape Valve
orbit.desc: Automatic pressure release valve preventing crystal dislodgement during decompression.

orbit.name: 5-Year Guarantee
orbit.desc: Comprehensive worldwide manufacturer warranty with complimentary 3rd-year maintenance.

story.title: The Aurelia Atelier Heritage
story.subtitle: Where Swiss Precision Meets Indian Craftsmanship
story.quote: In an era of fleeting digital seconds, Aurelia celebrates the timeless poetry of mechanical movements calibrated by master horologists.
story.author: Henri V. Aurelia
story.description: Every Aurelia timepiece begins as a symphony of raw marine-grade steel, synthetic ruby jewels, and hand-beveled balance springs. We bridge centuries of Swiss watchmaking heritage with contemporary industrial ergonomics.

craftsmanship.title: Assembled with Reverence
craftsmanship.subtitle: Every movement respects the balance between centuries of Swiss tradition and modern precision engineering.

items.title: 72-Hour Calibration Ritual
items.desc: Each caliber is regulated in five positions and three temperatures over three full days, so every second ticks true before it ever reaches your wrist.

items.title: Hand-Finished Côtes de Genève
items.desc: Bridges and rotors are striped and bevelled by hand under magnification, a finishing detail visible only through the sapphire caseback, yet never skipped.

items.title: Anti-Magnetic, Shock-Safe Precision
items.desc: Nivaflex mainspring, Glucydur balance and Incabloc shock protection keep timing stable through daily knocks, magnets and temperature swings.

expert.label: TRADITIONAL HOROLOGY
expert.quote: Most modern watches trade finishing for volume. Aurelia's hand-regulated calibers keep the old discipline alive: slower to make, far longer to last.

faqs.question: Are Aurelia watches really Swiss movement?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every timepiece uses a Swiss automatic caliber, individually regulated and tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: What does the 5-year warranty cover?
faqs.answer: It covers manufacturing defects in the movement and case worldwide, plus complimentary maintenance in the third year.

faqs.question: How is my watch shipped?
faqs.answer: Fully insured via express air courier with signature on delivery. Shipping is complimentary on orders above ₹999.

faqs.question: Can I return a watch if I change my mind?
faqs.answer: Yes. Unworn timepieces in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery.
